name: Knowledge
description: Ask the knowledge — Confluence's pages compiled into a knowledge graph by Zeff's knowledge server — in a chat with sources, have it read, keep something in it, and have its pages matched to your open todos.
author: Zeff

settings.label: Knowledge server address
settings.help: Leave empty for this account's own knowledge server (the launcher starts it). Only an address on this machine or your network.

settings.label: Knowledge server token
settings.help: Only when the server asks for one; empty keeps the token Zeff already has for this account.

aiTasks.label: Knowledge matching
aiTasks.what: Picks from the knowledge base's hits what really fits each todo.
